assessment_contract.qualification_focus: Write one concise exact-gradeable question asking what conversion during pyruvate oxidation links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the citric acid cycle. The supported answer must state that pyruvate is converted to acetyl-CoA.

evidence_quotes: **[00:00:00] Instructor:** Today we will follow one glucose molecule through
cellular respiration. The pathway has four teaching stages: glycolysis,
pyruvate oxidation, the citric acid cycle, and the electron transport chain
**[00:06:40] Instructor:** Pyruvate oxidation converts pyruvate to acetyl-CoA.
The citric acid cycle then oxidizes the acetyl group and captures energy in
NADH and FADH2 while releasing carbon dioxide.
